name: Archetype-Guided Event Category Pool
description: This file defines event categories for ReMem-RE. Each category is a template for a persistent semantic event object, not a concrete event instance and not a daily/session summary. The sampler should first sample persona archetypes, then sample compatible event categories, validate them, and then instantiate concrete event lines.
design_goals: Provide a sufficiently large ordinary-life event pool.
Support event-centered relational memory rather than topic-only or session-summary memory.
Cover work, money, housing, family, care, health routine, relationship, administration, retirement, and daily planning.
Allow compatibility validation through compatible_archetypes and incompatible_archetypes.
Avoid over-concentration on academic/research events or a single autobiographical pattern.

event_should_be: persistent or recurring across multiple sessions
personally meaningful for the sampled persona
